Validate a List of Analysis Workbook

Source: R/read_loa.R
validate_loa.Rd

Every check the schema defines, in one place. Never stops: it returns the problems so the app can show all of them at once instead of one per run.

Usage

validate_loa(workbook, dataset = NULL)

Arguments

workbook

The list returned by read_loa_workbook, or a bare named list of sheets.

dataset

Optional dataset, with the ONA label row still on top. When supplied, variable-existence and column-ownership checks are run.

Value

A data frame with sheet, row, severity and message.

Details

The severity rule, applied throughout: fatal when the run would produce wrong or misleading output; warning when it would only produce less output.
